def label_harvests(names, harvests):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> kilos dict and one 'name: kilos' line per harvest."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.kilos for x in harvests)))

    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
